testcase_description.digital_mytmoweb_home_bill_updateinstall:
EX - 1737
Log in to T-Mobile https://digital-qlab03.t-mobile.com

Identify a test account with an existing PA set up for the past due amount, where total balance would offer a wider date range

Navigate to the Manage PA screen, click "Edit," and note the current allowed date range for the past due PA

Switch the balance selection from "Past due" to "Total balance" on the Update page

Click on an installment date field to open the date picker

Verify the allowed date range now extends further than the previous past due boundary (up to the third bill due date)

Select a date that was previously unavailable under the past due range but is now available under total balance

Click "Update" and verify the new schedule reflects the expanded date on the Manage PA screen

testcase_description.digital_mytmoweb_home_bill_updateinstall:
EX - 1732
Log in to T-Mobile www.t-mobile.com 

Identify a test account with an existing 2-installment PA that is eligible for modification

Navigate to the Manage tab and click "Manage payment arrangement"

Click the "Edit" link next to the Payment Schedule section

Modify the date for Payment 2 by selecting an earlier or later date within the allowed range

Modify the Payment 1 amount by entering a different amount within the allowed range (above the minimum)

Verify the Total amount remains unchanged after adjusting the split between installments

Click "Update" to save the changes

Verify the landing/Manage PA screen reflects the updated dates and amounts
testcase_description.digital_mytmoweb_home_bill_daterangerema:
EX-1741
NOTE: Need a suspended account

Log in to T-Mobile https://digital-qlab03.t-mobile.com

Identify a test account that is involuntarily suspended and has an existing PA eligible for modification

Navigate to the Manage PA screen and click "Edit" on the Payment Schedule

Open the date picker for an installment and verify the available date range follows the 07/21-day rule for involuntarily suspended accounts

Modify an installment date within the allowed suspended account range

Modify the installment amount within the allowed range

Click "Update" to save the changes

Verify the Manage PA screen reflects the updated dates and amounts correctly

Verify the date range boundaries remain consistent and do not exceed the suspended account limits
